caliber.field_names: value.problem / value.automation / value.quality / value.cost / value.reproducibility / value.delivery — §6 verbatim
caliber.duration_mapping: The mission's 时长 dimension is recorded as value.cost.wall_clock_seconds (state it the same way for every pilot)
caliber.rule: An unevidenced dimension is written 'unknown' with a reason; it is never estimated, and 'unknown' is not 'planned'.
caliber.pv_note: PV (TensorData artifacts/pv-pilot/ex1_kcs/pilot_report.json@857a189 summary) records scenario metrics but no value block; the single caliber applied here is therefore §6 itself, and the unknowns below stay unknown rather than being back-filled from PV.

problem.decision_changed: Due-diligence intake of one inbound business plan: today a reviewer reads 19 pages by hand to find the ten quantities the intake checklist asks for, and the answer arrives without page-addressable provenance, so a second reviewer cannot re-check a number without re-reading the document.
problem.what_is_removed: Re-reading cost per number (every accepted value carries page_number + start/end offset + page_text_sha256 + value_sha256) and the silent-invention risk on a declared-absent quantity (funding_amount produced 0 proposals).
problem.limitation: No time-and-motion study of the current manual process was run, so no cost saving is quantified.

steps.evidence: review receipt six_checks[criteria_frozen_before_run] + validation_report scenario.limits[2] ('provisional author review')

steps.step: independent spot-check C7 (second code path, separate process)
report contract C10 + private containment C9

key_quantities.value: 22/22 approved fields: offset slice == raw value and page hash == page_text_sha256
4/4 corrupted inputs rejected with declared PdfEvidenceError and no artifact

key_quantities.quantity: legacy spectrum trade_documents_v1 on a business plan

miss_rate.reason: There is no labelled ground-truth corpus for this document type, so precision/recall over the extracted values cannot be computed; the pilot's overall_status is 'partial' for exactly this reason (validation_report.json scenario.limits).

human_baseline.reason: No human extraction of the same document was performed and timed, so 'quality vs a human reviewer' is unmeasured.

known_sub_field_limits: table_label_percent captures only the first percentage column of a multi-column table (README §5, failure_records record 3, resolution=accepted_limitation)
market_reference requires a parenthesised year, so 2 of 5 references on the source page were dropped (failure_records record 2, accepted_limitation)

compute.note: local control-plane process, no cluster job submitted

human_review_minutes.reason: The pilot review was a provisional author review with no timestamped reviewer log, so review minutes are not recorded.

demo_chain.note: docs/m22925/demo/timing.json — the packaging demo (1-page synthetic invoice) timed per stage; reported separately from the pilot so the two are not conflated.

delivery.reason: No consuming owner has stated acceptance of the output as-is; there is no owner statement or record to cite. Per §6 an absent statement is 'unknown', not 'planned'.

admissibility.framework_rule: A pilot with any dimension 'unknown' may still be accepted as partial, but cannot be promoted to a calibrated/operational claim (G3/G4 in docs/FOUR_PRODUCT_ACCEPTANCE_MATRIX.md).
admissibility.consequence_here: BE stays a partial/level-3 claim: scenario_validated=true is backed by the independent receipt (verdict=pass), while the quality-vs-human, review-minutes and delivery dimensions remain unknown.
